YouTube has extraordinary things on it for children.
slides.body: I still think that. My three have learned real things from it.

slides.big: Then a video about relationships turned up in the recommendations.
slides.body: I hadn't gone looking for it. The recommendations brought it.

A parent chooses the first video.
Who chooses the next one?
I watched my children go from one video to the next.
slides.body: And I saw how little say a parent has over where it ends up.
